# Backlog

## Stories

- As a returning shopper, I want to save my card so that I can check out in one tap.
- As a finance analyst, I want a settlement report so that I can reconcile payouts.
- As a merchant, I want to be emailed when a payout is sent, so that I know when to expect the money.
- As a traveller, I want to change my booking date once for free, so that I can rearrange without losing the fare.
- As a support agent, I want to see a customer's last five orders on the ticket, so that I can answer without asking them to repeat details.
